title: Improve magic link email styling with dark/light mode support
description: Make the magic link email visually appealing with proper dark/light mode support. The email should match SongScript branding and look professional.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Email detects user's color scheme preference (prefers-color-scheme)
Light mode: clean white background with dark text
Dark mode: dark background with light text
SongScript branding (logo or app name) in header
Clear, prominent 'Sign In' button with brand colors

notes: Email template is in convex/betterAuth.ts sendMagicLink function. Use inline CSS with @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) for dark mode support.
